describes: The launch allowlist. A restaurant is certifiable if its certificate is issued by ANY ONE of these bodies (check H2_ISSUER_ACCEPTED). Client-supplied, resolves blocking decision O-02. Additional bodies are added at runtime by a super admin via proposeHalalIssuingBody + setHalalIssuingBodyStatus — this seed is the starting registry, not a closed set.

payload.name: Halal Monitoring Authority Canada
payload.notes: Launch allowlist per decision O-02. Registration details to be confirmed by the client before go-live.

payload.name: Halal Food Standards Alliance of America
payload.notes: Launch allowlist per decision O-02. US-based body recognised for North American certification; confirm scope applicability for Canadian premises before go-live.

payload.notes: Launch allowlist per decision O-02. Registration details to be confirmed by the client before go-live.
